avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer significantly reduces cobicistat levels and effectiveness of co-administered antiretrovirals
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; do not use concurrently. Counsel patient to avoid all St. John's Wort products

avoid_supplements.name: Garlic (high-dose supplements)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may reduce cobicistat plasma concentration and protease inhibitor efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose garlic supplements; culinary amounts acceptable

avoid_supplements.name: Rifabutin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inducer; cobicistat increases rifabutin levels 3-4 fold, increasing toxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; use alternative TB therapy if possible or reduce rifabutin dose significantly with careful monitoring

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: May inhibit CYP3A4 and increase cobicistat levels unpredictably
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor for increased adverse effects or consider avoiding

caution_supplements.name: Milk thistle
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have CYP3A4 effects; potential for altered cobicistat metabolism
caution_supplements.action: Inform patient of potential interaction; monitor clinical response

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases cobicistat and protease inhibitor concentrations; unpredictable effect magnitude
avoid_foods.action: Strictly avoid grapefruit and grapefruit juice; counsel on importance of dietary restriction

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: Food effect variable; may increase cobicistat absorption when used with certain regimens
caution_foods.action: Administer with food as directed; maintain consistent dietary patterns with cobicistat-containing products

monitoring_notes: Cobicistat is a potent CYP3A4 inhibitor used to boost protease inhibitor and integrase inhibitor concentrations; monitor for increased adverse effects from co-administered drugs and ensure patient awareness of critical dietary restrictions. Regular assessment of viral suppression and tolerability is essential, particularly with polypharmacy in HIV treatment regimens.
